newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Inkombank sees first ADR deal next week.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Inkombank sees first ADR deal next week.

text.p: Russia's AB Inkombank said on Tuesday that the first deal with its level-one American Depositary Receipts would take place next week.
"Maybe, it'll happen at the end of this week, but most likely next week," an Inkombank spokesman told Reuters.
Previously the bank said the first deal will take place at the start of this week.
The bank plans to sell nine million ordinary shares through the ADRs issue and hopes to get about $0.80 per 1,000 rouble share.
The placement will be a public one with possibly a small portion allocated for a private placement.
The bank does not have a lead manager for the project.
Bank of New York is Inkombank's depositor and ING-Bank Euroasia will be the custodian.
Inkombank plans to issue level-two and level-three ADRs, which unlike level-one receipts raise new capital, in 1997 or 1998.
